Pre-filter a large table as a CTE before the join
reached_sql:
WITH top_ranked AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        i_category,
        i_class,
        i_brand,
        i_product_name,
        d_year,
        d_qoy,
        d_moy,
        s_store_id,
        sumsales,
        rk
    FROM (
        SELECT
            i_category,
            i_class,
            i_brand,
            i_product_name,
            d_year,
            d_qoy,
            d_moy,
            s_store_id,
            sumsales,
            RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY sumsales DESC) AS rk
        FROM (
            SELECT
                i_category,
                i_class,
                i_brand,
                i_product_name,
                d_year,
                d_qoy,
                d_moy,
                s_store_id,
                SUM(COALESCE(ss_sales_price * ss_quantity, 0)) AS sumsales
            FROM store_sales
            JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
            JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
            JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
            WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1217+11
            GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
                (i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id),
                (i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy),
                (i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy),
                (i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year),
                (i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name),
                (i_category, i_class, i_brand),
                (i_category, i_class),
                (i_category),
                ()
            )
        ) AS agg
    ) AS ranked_rows
    WHERE rk <= 100
)
SELECT *
FROM top_ranked
ORDER BY
    i_category,
    i_class,
    i_brand,
    i_product_name,
    d_year,
    d_qoy,
    d_moy,
    s_store_id,
    sumsales,
    rk
LIMIT 100
